data.one_liner: Secure key-value storage using platform-specific secure mechanisms
data.what_it_does: Provides encrypted storage for sensitive data on Android, iOS, macOS, Windows, Linux, and Web. It uses platform keychains or custom ciphers and supports optional biometric authentication.
use_when: Persisting small amounts of sensitive configuration
avoid_when: Using it as a general-purpose database
Relying on it for non-sensitive data
strengths: Built-in encryption with RSA OAEP + AES-GCM
Optional biometric authentication and accessibility options
weaknesses: Web support limited to HTTPS or localhost
Requires native configuration (e.g., disabling backup on Android)
No built-in migration for schema changes
data.setup_notes: Call WidgetsFlutterBinding.ensureInitialized(); disable Android backup via AndroidManifest; use HTTPS for Web; add dependency in pubspec.yaml
